title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
description: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.

title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
description: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.

title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
description: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
description: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.

title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
description: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
description: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

title: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
description: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt. title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it

title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
description: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
description: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter.

title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
description: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
description: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
description: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
description: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
description: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
description: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
description: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
description: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.

title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
description: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the day count for your business.

title: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
description: We'll likely learn more about how this will work at the company's upcoming "AI & Autonomy Day" event in December.
